quirks.description: Prismic's image CDN is powered by Imgix. Full Imgix rendering API available on images.prismic.io URLs (NOT on SVGs from cdn.prismic.io).
quirks.workaround: Use Imgix params directly for advanced transforms (blur, saturation, contrast). Reference Imgix docs for complete param list.

quirks.description: Default ?auto=compress,format serves AVIF/WebP based on browser support.
quirks.workaround: Always include ?auto=compress,format for production. Omit for download to get original format.

quirks.description: Prismic uses ?rect=x,y,w,h for pixel-level crop coordinates set via the editor's crop tool.
quirks.workaround: Preserve ?rect= params — they represent editorial crop decisions.
Extract repo name from first path segment after domain.

quirks.description: SVGs are NOT served from images.prismic.io. They come from <repo>.cdn.prismic.io due to security (SVGs can contain injected JS). Imgix params have no effect on SVGs.
quirks.workaround: Check domain before applying imgix transforms. If cdn.prismic.io, skip imgix params and download raw.

quirks.description: Older assets (RichText-embedded images) may still be served from prismic-io.s3.amazonaws.com. These lack imgix optimization.
quirks.workaround: Download as raw files without imgix params.

quirks.description: Two coexisting asset ID formats: legacy UUID (dcea6535-...-bf281aaf1cb2_file.png) and new short-ID (aMFZEGGNHVfTO_De_file.png).
quirks.workaround: Updated assetIdPattern matches both UUID and short base64 IDs.
